newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norsk Hydro gives Kvaerner NOK 400 mln oil deal.
newsitem.headline: Norsk Hydro gives Kvaerner NOK 400 mln oil deal.

text.p: Norsk Hydro ASA said on Tuesday it had awarded a 400 million crown contract to Kvaerner ASA for development and upgrading of the Oseberg oil field in the North Sea.

The contract covers modification and hook up on the Oseberg Field Centre with Oseberg South and Oseberg East and the hook up of the new Oseberg D gas platform, which is due to start up in October 1999.
The deal with Kvaerner Installasjon AS includes engineering, procurement, offshore installation and required modications at the field centre.

Hydro is operator for the Oseberg field, cover by production licences PL053 and PL079, and holds 13.68 percent of the licence. Partners are Den norske stats oljeselskap AS with 64.78 percent, Saga Petroleum ASA with 8.55 percent, Elf Petroleum with 5.77 percent, Mobil with 4.33 percent and Total with 2.88 percent.
